SamenvattingTake on the role of a Production Operator and play an active part in a dynamic environment where your skills truly make an impact.Over de functieAs a Machine Operator in Giessen, you’ll play a key role in the production process. Your main responsibility is to operate and monitor packaging machines, ensuring that all products meet the highest quality standards.
In this fast-paced production environment, you’ll be responsible for maintaining equipment, keeping the production line running smoothly, and resolving any technical issues that arise.
Your main duties include:
- Safely and efficiently operating packaging machines

- Conducting quality checks to maintain product standards

- Performing regular maintenance on machinery

This is a full-time position primarily during weekdays, though occasional weekend shifts may be required—with additional pay provided.
The work is organized in a 3-shift rotation (Monday to Friday):
- Morning shift: 6:00 a.m. – 2:45 p.m.

- Afternoon shift: 2:00 p.m. – 10:45 p.m.

- Night shift: 10:00 p.m. – 6:45 a.m.

Over het bedrijfWe are dedicated to producing a wide variety of nut-based snacks and take pride in delivering top-quality products to our customers. Our modern production facility provides the foundation for this commitment. The team you’ll join is both dynamic and supportive—always ready to lend a hand and keep the atmosphere positive. We value dedication and efficiency while fostering a workplace where everyone feels recognized, motivated, and part of the success.
Wat wij vragen- Previous production experience, ideally within the food industry or in an operator role

- Skilled in operating and troubleshooting packaging machinery

- Strong command of spoken English

- Ability to work with precision and efficiency in a fast-paced environment

Wat wij bieden- Hourly wage: starting from around €20 per hour (included shift allowance)

- Shift allowance: +14% for 2-shift schedule / +19% for 3-shift sc

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a job as a Warehouse Worker in Tilburg? GXO Logistics is looking for motivated people to join the team. 

We will apply for the TWV (work permit) for you if needed. 

Mandatory Requirements: your own accommodation, your own transportation, a valid ID or Passport and a valid physical BSN document are required for this job. 

As a Warehouse Worker at GXO in Tilburg, you will work in a large and modern warehouse. You will help prepare orders and make sure products are ready on time. 

The job is active. You will stand and walk a lot during your work. We have different departments 

- Picking 

- Packing 

You will work 32–40 hours per week, from Monday to Saturday, in 2 shifts: 

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 14:45 

- Evening shift: 15:15 – 00:00 

You will receive training before you start working independently. 

You are motivated and ready to work in a busy warehouse. 

What you need: 

- You speak and understand English. 

- You can work at least 4 days per week. 

- You are able to work in 2 shifts. 

- You have your own accommodation – mandatory. 

- You have your own transportation – mandatory. 

- You have a valid BSN document – mandatory. 

- You are able to do active work and follow work instructions. 

- TWV 

We will apply for the TWV (work permit) for you if needed. 

You can start working after the TWV has been approved. Please note: TWV approval can take up to 6 weeks 

Important: Please apply only if you already have your own accommodation, your own transportation and a valid BSN document.

Salary €14.99 per hour + opportunity for a pay increase after 26 worked weeks

Are you looking for an active job where you can start right away? Do you enjoy hands-on work and being part of a friendly team? Then this Production Employee position in Tiel could be perfect for you!

What will you do?

As a Production Employee, you and your colleagues ensure that hospital clothing and other textiles are cleaned, sorted, and prepared for use on time. You will work in a modern production environment where the pace is high and no two days are the same.

Your tasks include:

- Sorting incoming laundry
- Operating washing and production machines
- Checking the quality of cleaned textiles
- Preparing clothing and linen for shipment
- Working together with colleagues to meet daily production targets

You will work in different shifts:

- Early shift: 06:00 AM - 11:00 AM
- Day shift: 11:00 AM - 04:00 PM
- Extended day shift: 06:00 AM - 04:00 PM

Do you prefer one of these shifts? Let's discuss the possibilities!

- You have an MBO-level (vocational) working and thinking ability
- No previous work experience is required
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are flexible and available to work different shifts
- You work accurately and can keep up with a fast pace
- You live within approximately 20 kilometers of Tiel

Are you an experienced operator and would you like to work with fresh products in a clean and modern production environment? Apply now and join the team at an international production company in the Deurne region!

What will you do?
As an operator, you are responsible for a smooth production process. You make sure the machines are set correctly and that problems are solved quickly. You work closely with your team and guide colleagues when needed.

Your tasks will include:

- Setting up and starting production lines
- Monitoring the production process and product quality
- Solving small machine problems or calling the technical service
- Arranging the supply of raw materials
- Performing quality checks and HACCP registrations
- Supervising production workers on your line

As an operator:

- You have experience as an operator or in production
- You have a good level of Dutch or English
- You live in the region of Eindhoven, Helmond, Weert, Veldhoven, Deurne or Venray

Looking for a job in Tilburg with awesome hourly pay and unbeatable shift bonuses? Join SodaStream as a production worker and power up your career! Earn €15,13 per hour, boost your paycheck with allowances up to 18,44% per hour, and count on a stable 37,5 hour workweek. 🤑 And if you don’t have any sick days in a quarter, you get a bonus of €400! 💸 Get ready to roll up your sleeves and keep lines running smoothly! ⚡

What we offer
- Hourly salary of €15,13
- Shift allowances up to 18,44% per hour
- Fixed 37,5 hours per week
- Travel allowance of €0,21

Who you are
To keep the filling department running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production worker:

- You are available fulltime;

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can reach their destination on time.

You can start as a Loader, where you place packages onto the conveyor belt, or as an Unloader, where you remove sorted packages from the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. As you gain more experience, you will have the opportunity to perform a variety of tasks within the sorting center.

You will work the evening shift, which starts between 4:30 PM and 5:30 PM and ends at 1:00 AM.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available 2 or 3 days per week, on Monday, Tuesday and/or Wednesday
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are at least 18 years old
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center
- You are able to lift packages weighing up to 25 kg

- Earn € 19.90 per hour (2 shifts, with allowances)!
